checks.title: Missing values present
checks.explanation: Blank values can affect statistics and model preparation.
checks.recommendation: Review missingness by column. If you impute, document the method and validate its impact.

checks.title: Possible numeric outliers
checks.explanation: The 1.5 × IQR rule identifies unusual observations; these can be correct values.
checks.recommendation: Investigate the source, units, and distribution before modifying any flagged value.

checks.title: Potential identifier columns
checks.evidence: 3 header(s) resemble IDs or contact fields
checks.explanation: Column names provide only a heuristic; values were not verified for privacy or identity.
checks.recommendation: Exclude identifiers and sensitive information as appropriate before modeling or sharing reports.

checks.title: Small dataset
checks.explanation: Statistical patterns based on small samples may be unstable.
checks.recommendation: Do not interpret this dataset alone as sufficient for reliable machine learning.

methodology.missing: Cell is missing when empty or whitespace-only.
methodology.duplicates: Exact row matches use string equality in original column order.
methodology.types: Inferred by heuristics; numeric identifiers may be misclassified.
methodology.quartiles: Linear interpolation of sorted values at (n-1)*p.
methodology.outliers: 1.5 × IQR; only numeric fields with >=4 values and nonzero IQR. Identifier-like headers are excluded from warning summary.
methodology.quality_decision: No composite readiness score: checks are transparent and contextual.
methodology.target_label: No target was selected; label leakage, validation strategy, representation and fairness were not assessed.

limitations: Educational quality screening, not an AI model and not an ML-readiness certification.
CSV type inference is heuristic and may be wrong.
Statistical aggregates and column names can themselves be sensitive even without raw rows.
No assessment of bias, data provenance, label leakage, domain constraints, or actual model performance.
The source file remains in the browser; downloadable reports are generated locally and are not uploaded.
privacy: Exports contain column names and aggregate statistics, not individual CSV records.
